== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Alternatives To Fighting (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Alternatives To Fighting (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
